title: FlyAlloc 合成演示

generation.method: Deterministic sine/cosine returns and weights; integer activity pattern
generation.dates: Weekday placeholders, not an exchange calendar
generation.notice: All assets, returns, allocations and activity are artificial interface examples; not model inference or research performance.

activationNormalization: Artificial integer values in [0,255]; no training quantiles used

graph.layout_note: No synthetic coordinates represented as anatomy.
graph.selection: 384 largest traced cell-type/consensus-transmitter groups by neuron count, lexical tie break; no market inputs.
graph.normalization: Top 32 incoming aggregate counts per target; signed outgoing transmitter convention; each nonzero absolute row sum scaled to 0.9.
graph.sign_assumption: Acetylcholine +1; GABA, glutamate, histamine -1. Engineered convention; receptor-specific sign and neuromodulatory physiology are not modeled.
graph.excluded: Untraced, untyped, unclear transmitter, and modulatory transmitter bodies; groups outside population-based top384.
graph.attribution: FlyEM (HHMI Janelia), University of Cambridge, MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology, Google Research
graph.weight_source: Untrained public aggregate reservoir matrix; no fitted portfolio readout or market-trained edge weights.
graph.modifications: 384 cell-type/transmitter groups; aggregate directed edges, incoming-edge cap, engineered transmitter signs and row normalization. Display positions are schematic.
graph.demo_notice: Connectivity is derived from real MaleCNS data under CC BY 4.0. Demonstration activity is generated independently by arithmetic formulas, not by this graph or a trained model.

feeDescription: 人工示例每边按 5bp 计算；并非真实执行成本。
baselineLabel: 七项虚构资产买持示例
modelDescription: 未加载或运行模型；权重、收益与活动由固定算式独立生成。
caveat: 合成演示仅用于验证界面，不是研究结果、投资策略或未来收益证据。
